problem: Sum invoice totals once per invoice that has at least one tag. Exclude untagged invoices.

queries.join_duplicates_invoice: SELECT SUM(i.total_cents) FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_tags t ON t.invoice_id = i.id
queries.distinct_amount_discards_equal_invoice: SELECT SUM(DISTINCT i.total_cents) FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_tags t ON t.invoice_id = i.id
queries.exists_counts_each_tagged_invoice_once: SELECT SUM(i.total_cents) FROM invoices i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_tags t WHERE t.invoice_id = i.id)
